svg.aria-label: One-on-one message flow. 1 User A sends a message over WebSocket to chat server 1. 2 The server gets a message ID from the ID generator. 3 It puts the message on the message sync queue (B's inbox). 4 The message is stored in the key-value store. 5a If User B is online, it goes to chat server 2, which B is connected to; 5b if B is offline, push notification servers alert B. 6 Chat server 2 delivers it to User B over WebSocket. Presence servers, API servers and service discovery (ZooKeeper) complete the system.
svg.title: Chat system and 1-on-1 message flow
